description: Inspect monthly FBI UCR population coverage for one state in LiveDataLink's self-hosted CDE aggregate snapshot before interpreting its summarized crime trend. Returns reporting population, full population, coverage percentage, an explicit warning below 90 percent, pagination, and provenance. Use this for 'was California's 2021 FBI reporting coverage complete?', 'find low-coverage months in this state period', or to qualify an analysis. Coverage is not data quality proof and must accompany, not replace, methodological review.

end_month.description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format within the hosted snapshot.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

start_month.description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format within the hosted snapshot.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state or District of Columbia abbreviation; US is not accepted.

name: fbi_cde_state_reporting_coverage
